edition.en: Text of Lamia, Isabella, The Eve of St. Agnes, and Other Poems (1820), from M. Robertson’s 1909 reprint on Project Gutenberg (eBook 23684); stanza numbers omitted
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 23684（罗伯逊 1909 年重印的 1820 年诗集）；略去诗节编号

basis.en: Published in 1820; the author died in 1821.
basis.zh: 1820 年出版；作者卒于 1821 年。

note.en: Written in September 1819 after a walk near Winchester, this is often called the most perfect short poem in English. It moves through a single day and a single season at once, from ripening morning to swallows gathering at dusk. Nothing in it argues; it simply attends, and that is the lesson.
note.zh: 1819 年 9 月济慈在温彻斯特附近散步后写成，常被称为英语里最完美的短诗。它同时走过一天和一个季节：从成熟的早晨，到黄昏时聚集的燕子。诗里什么也不争辩，只是专注地看——这就是它教人的东西。

excerpt.orig:
Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness,
Close bosom-friend of the maturing sun;
excerpt.en:
Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness,
Close bosom-friend of the maturing sun;
excerpt.zh:
雾气与醇熟丰饶的季节，
你是那催熟万物的太阳的知心密友；
